plan.evidence_kind: self_authored_constructed_reference_implementation; not independent preregistration or Agent experiment
plan.state_effect_window: next sequential request after committed fixture; no concurrent writers
plan.worker_boundary: fresh OS process, fresh pipes and instance id; stateless request relay; no LLM or learned policy
retained_state: same gate object and cache per trace
same SQLite connection and event rows
same dummy tool process and receipts per trace
plan.fixture_authority: test controller injects source action, obligation and valid settlement; not observed Agent misconduct, autonomous correction or real authentication
plan.rules: same base permission for both identities; deny only subject/item pair with unclosed obligation; settlement effective immediately; decisions do not depend on worker PID or labels A/B
plan.tool_effect: separate tool process durably appends a dummy receipt; no external resource
observations: child start/exit with PID and monotonic time
separately written tool receipt file after every request
plan.failure_criteria: absent or late evidence/unclean process exit => execution error or inconclusive; complete records with wrong decision/effect => mechanism mismatch; no post-run changes to expectations
plan.interpretation_limit: Only constructed mechanism in this serial trusted-controller scope. S contains history and feedback; worker relay is not an Agent. No complete P1/P2 test, strong experience absence, security, crash recovery, long-run reliability or external-system replication claim.
